newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KLINSMANN LURED BY SAMPDORIA'S ATTACKING GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLINSMANN LURED BY SAMPDORIA'S ATTACKING GAME.

text.p: Juergen Klinsmann has decided to join Sampdoria at the end of the season because he believes the Italian club will provide a boost to both his scoring talents and his private life after a difficult time at Bayern Munich.

Asked on Friday why he had decided to return to Italy where he used to play for Internazionale Milan, Klinsmann said: "Sampdoria are the most attacking team in Italy. They have scored more goals than any other Italian side in the league."
"And it's a family decision too. We like the country. It is only an hour-and-a-quarter from Milan," added the German captain who also had offers from clubs in England and Spain.
The 32-year-old striker's move from Bayern was announced formally by the northwestern serie A club on Friday in a short statement that implied a one-year contract.

Klinsmann, who recently became a father for the first time, has been unhappy at Bayern for some time because of the defensive tactics of Italian coach Giovanni Trapattoni. He also feels he has been treated badly at the club.
But he managed to get on the scoresheet with the second goal in Bayern's 3-0 league win at Hansa Rostock on Friday which kept the club on course for the championship.
